title: Thai-Style Barbeque Chicken
description: Sweet and spicy Thai-inspired barbeque chicken, perfect for a quick dinner. Serve with steamed vegetables and rice for a balanced meal.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: available in most supermarkets or Asian markets

instructions: 1. Cook the quick-cooking rice according to the package instructions. Set aside.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together curry paste, barbeque sauce, brown sugar, and sesame oil.
3. Add the chicken breasts to the marinade and mix until well-coated.
4. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Grill the marinated chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. In a separate pan, heat the marinade over medium heat until slightly thickened.
6. Slice the grilled chicken into thin strips.
7. Add the sliced chicken, khanom jeen noodles, and chopped Thai basil to the pan with the marinade.
8. Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
9. Serve the Thai-Style Barbeque Chicken over the cooked quick-cooking rice.
10. Garnish with additional Thai basil, if desired.
